title: Memory leaks in src/engine/reconstruction.zig deserializeInstanceState
symptom: 6,976 memory leaks during event replay in reconstruction functions. Leaks occur at lines 707, 709, 752 in deserializeInstanceState when allocating ObjectMap keys and values from JSON.
impact: Test suite exits with code 1 due to leak detection, though functional tests pass. Memory accumulation during reconstruction of instances with large event histories.
root_cause: ObjectMap keys and nested JsonValue objects allocated during deserializeInstanceState are not freed. This is separate from the ISS-0601-LEAK-001 (parseGraphJson) issue which was successfully resolved.
notes: Discovered during WF03-gh406-20260803 rework iterations. Arena allocator attempts (rework 2/3) introduced massive regressions (131-142 test failures). Decision made to accept rework 1 state (core parseGraphJson leak fixed) and address reconstruction leaks separately.
